methodology: Synthetic 10,000-row CSV in an isolated Electron profile; real Worker decode, virtual-table mount, one viewport scroll, one keyboard edit, and a separate synthetic Worker encoder measurement. No user data or production Library was opened.
notes: The Electron path proves real layout, scroll-window movement, focus, Enter commit, and bounded visible DOM rows.
The Vitest encoder path measures the same Worker-owned encoder used by CSV export; exact bytes remain covered by baseline-csv.test.mjs.
No claim of a full hardware FPS trace is made from these single-event measurements; the observed scroll/edit timings are retained for Sol's independent review.
